wage_2017 AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_wkly_wage_10_total_all_industries) as avg_wage
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.bls_qcew.2017_q1` WHERE geoid = '42003'

  SELECT value as cpi FROM `bigquery-public-data.bls.cpi_u` 
  WHERE area_name = 'U.S. city average' AND item_code = 'SA0' AND series_id = 'CUSR0000SA0' AND year = 1998 AND period = 'M12'
),
cpi_2017 AS (
  SELECT value as cpi FROM `bigquery-public-data.bls.cpi_u` 
  WHERE area_name = 'U.S. city average' AND item_code = 'SA0' AND series_id = 'CUSR0000SA0' AND year = 2017 AND period = 'M12'

  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE((SELECT AVG(avg_wage) FROM wage_2017) - (SELECT AVG(avg_wage) FROM wage_1998), (SELECT AVG(avg_wage) FROM wage_1998)) * 100, 2) as wage_growth_pct,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE((SELECT cpi FROM cpi_2017) - (SELECT cpi FROM cpi_1998), (SELECT cpi FROM cpi_1998)) * 100, 2) as cpi_growth_pct
